name: Three Castles, Defensive Wall and Ramparts of the Market-Town of Bellinzona
description: In the Swiss canton of Ticino, three stone castles rise above the town of Bellinzona. Castelgrande crowns a rocky hill over the valley floor, and long defensive walls run from it across the valley to Montebello, shutting off the route through the Alps. Sasso Corbaro, the highest of the three, stands apart on a lonely crag to the south-east.
